notes.zh-CN: 手机端新增安全保存登录状态，首次登录后最多保留 30 天，关闭或重启 App 后自动恢复并续期，不必每次重新进行飞书授权。断网保留登录，主动退出、移除电脑或授权失效时清除。凭据使用 iOS 钥匙串和 Android Keystore 加密存储。macOS 为通用包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Mobile sign-in is securely saved for up to 30 days from the initial authorization, with automatic restore and token renewal after app restarts. Network failures preserve the saved login; signing out, removing the computer or revoked authorization clears it. Credentials use iOS Keychain and Android Keystore encryption. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
